classifications.notes: Andrew Ng speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt SF 2017. Close-up portrait, light blue button-down shirt, gesturing with hands. 'DISRUPT' branding visible in background.
YouTube thumbnail for Andrej Karpathy's 'Software in the era of AI' talk. Y Combinator branding, orange background, labeled 'Founding Member, OpenAI'. Smiling headshot in dark t-shirt.

Google I/O developer conference branding graphic. Colorful abstract icons (Android robot, globe, code brackets, play button) on black background. No people visible — this is purely a logo/branding image, not a photo of Sundar Pichai.
YouTube thumbnail of Satya Nadella on stage at Microsoft Build 2025 Keynote. He stands alone on a large minimalist stage. Microsoft logo and 'Microsoft Build 2025 Keynote' text overlay. Dark outfit.
Mark Zuckerberg at outdoor social event wearing black 'Carthago' t-shirt and gold chain necklace, curly hair, holding a drink, laughing. String lights in background. The viral 'new Zuck' image.

East Asian man in white Ralph Gracie Jiu-Jitsu gi with BJJ Tour gold medal at a tournament. This is NOT Mark Zuckerberg — the person in the image does not match Zuckerberg's appearance. Possible misattributed image. Filename suggests 'jeff1'.

Two-panel image. Left: Mark Zuckerberg squaring up with two UFC fighters (one Black, one with buzz cut) in an octagon cage, all smiling. Right: Zuckerberg grappling/sparring on the mat. MMA training session.
Mark Zuckerberg hydrofoiling on a lake at sunset, holding a large American flag. Mountains and forest in background. The iconic July 4th viral moment. Beautiful golden-hour lighting.

Elon Musk smoking weed on Joe Rogan's podcast (September 2018). Close-up shot, wearing black 'Occupy' t-shirt and headphones, exhaling smoke with a smirk. Microphone visible, dark curtain background. One of the most iconic viral tech moments.

Elon Musk carrying a white porcelain sink into Twitter HQ lobby, smiling. Modern office lobby with marble columns, glass doors, leather furniture. The '$44B acquisition dad joke' moment — October 2022.
Elon Musk standing in front of Tesla Cybertruck with visibly shattered 'armor glass' window. All-black outfit on dark stage. BBC News watermark. The infamous November 2019 product reveal fail.

CNBC YouTube thumbnail: 'OPENAI CEO TESTIFIES BEFORE CONGRESS'. Sam Altman speaking animatedly with hand raised, wearing lavalier mic. TechCrunch Disrupt branding visible in background. Historic AI regulation testimony moment.

classifications.current_label: Thiel Plays PayPal Staff at Chess
classifications.notes: Outdoor chess event at PayPal. Man in white shirt celebrating with arms raised triumphantly. Chess board on table, crowd of ~15 employees watching and laughing. Some people wearing paper crowns. Early PayPal era photo, from @TechBroDrip.

Jensen Huang (leather jacket, left) presenting/touching an NVIDIA DGX server on a table while Elon Musk (dark blazer, arms crossed, right) watches. Office setting with motivational quote on wall. Historic 2016 moment — first DGX delivered to OpenAI.

Two men carrying cardboard boxes outside Twitter HQ, pretending to be fired employees. The 'Rahul Ligma' and 'Daniel Johnson' prank that fooled major news outlets during the Elon Musk Twitter acquisition. October 2022. From @TechBroDrip.

Mark Zuckerberg (tiger-print shirt, sunglasses, curly hair) gesturing while talking with Bill Gates (black blazer, green polo, glasses) and a woman in patterned outfit. Appears to be at an Indian social event/wedding. From @TechBroDrip.

Candid paparazzi-style shot through restaurant window. Tim Cook (left, glasses, dark sweater) and Sundar Pichai (right, glasses, dark shirt) having dinner at a white-tablecloth restaurant. Shot from outside looking in. From @TechBroDrip.

Three side-by-side headshot portraits: Elon Musk (left, dark blazer, blue background), Peter Thiel (center, navy blazer, white shirt, smiling), and a third man (right, dark suit, red tie, blondish hair — possibly David Sacks). NOT the famous Fortune magazine 'PayPal Mafia' group cover; this is a modern headshot composite.

Classic black-and-white photo of Steve Wozniak (standing, long hair, glasses, button-up shirt) and Steve Jobs (seated, young, dark hair, t-shirt) with Apple I circuit board and CRT monitor displaying code. Screen shows 'HELP ME' text. Iconic founding-era photo circa 1976.

Google Street View panorama of Susan Wojcicki's garage in Menlo Park — where Google was founded. Labeled 'Susan's Garage' with Google Maps UI visible. Cluttered garage with wooden round table, shelving, bicycle, old CRT computer, boxes. Sep 2018 capture. No people.

Larry Page (seated, plaid shirt) and Sergey Brin (standing, blue button-up) in their garage office circa 1999. CRT monitor with early Google visible. Cluttered startup workspace with boxes and equipment. Warm vintage color tones. Two young Stanford PhDs who built one of the most valuable companies in history.
